aviation_incidents.headline: 印度A321neo客機乘客應對頭頂行李櫃行動電源起火，航班改道
aviation_incidents.summary: 印度A321neo客機上的乘客在頭頂行李櫃應對行動電源起火。報導標題稱，飛機被迫改道；摘要則說，旅客當時正在印度境內行程中，並努力阻止火焰蔓延。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Passengers Battle Power Bank Fire Aboard Indian A321neo; Flight Diverts
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Simple Flying reported that passengers aboard an Indian A321neo battled a power bank fire in an overhead bin. The headline says the aircraft was forced to divert. The summary describes the flight as a trip across India and says travelers struggled to stop the flames from spreading.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 中華航空桃園往返香港航班10月25日起移至第二航廈　報到、出入境及行李提領同步調整
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中華航空公告，自2026年10月25日起，往返臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）與香港國際機場（HKG）的華航航班，將改於桃園機場第二航廈（T2）營運，旅客報到、出入境及行李提領等相關作業同步移至第二航廈辦理。華航已於9月10日在官網發布相關通知。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines Taoyuan–Hong Kong Flights Move to Terminal 2 From October 25
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines has announced that its flights between Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) will operate from Terminal 2 (T2) at Taoyuan Airport from October 25, 2026. Passenger check-in, departure and arrival immigration procedures, and baggage claim will also move to Terminal 2. The airline published the notice on its website on September 10.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空9月營收年增69% 客運與貨運同步成長
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空9月營收為新臺幣49.75億元，年增69%。其中，客運營收37.2億元，年增70%；貨運營收7.06億元，月增5%、年增59%。星宇航空表示，傳統貨運旺季到來，AI伺服器供應鏈拉貨、半導體設備及電子零組件出貨，以及年底購物季備貨需求升溫，航空貨運市場艙位需求持續增溫，公司看好未來貨運市場。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Starlux September Revenue Rises 69% as Passenger and Cargo Sales Grow
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Starlux Airlines reported September revenue of NT$4.975 billion, up 69% year on year. Passenger revenue was NT$3.72 billion, up 70%, while cargo revenue reached NT$706 million, up 5% from August and 59% year on year. The airline said the traditional cargo peak season was arriving, with demand from the AI-server supply chain, shipments of semiconductor equipment and electronic components, and year-end shopping-season stocking needs contributing to stronger demand for air-cargo capacity. Starlux said it was optimistic about the cargo market.

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍沙漠演習暴露新興技術限制
international_aviation.summary: 美國陸軍的 Project Convergence-Capstone 6 演習旨在於接近實際條件下測試新興技術與戰場網路，並測試下一代指揮與控制（NGC2）架構、無人機、自主系統及電子戰裝備。這場為期十天的 Project Convergence 演習於七月在莫哈維沙漠的 Fort Irwin 舉行；報導指出，演習暴露出顯著限制。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Army desert exercise exposes limits in emerging technology
international_aviation.summary_en: The US Army’s Project Convergence-Capstone 6 exercise was designed to stress-test emerging technologies and battlefield networks under realistic conditions. It tested the Next Generation Command and Control architecture, drones, autonomous systems and electronic warfare equipment. The ten-day Project Convergence exercise took place in July at Fort Irwin in the Mojave Desert; the report said it exposed significant limitations.

international_aviation.summary: 飛機租賃公司Avolon表示，已向空中巴士與波音訂購250架新飛機。這批訂單包括140架波音737 MAX，以及110架空中巴士飛機，其中包括75架A320neo系列與35架A330neo系列飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Avolon Announces 250 Airbus and Boeing Aircraft Orders, Pending Approval
international_aviation.summary_en: Aircraft lessor Avolon says it has placed orders for 250 new aircraft from Airbus and Boeing. The announced breakdown is 140 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft and 110 Airbus jets, including 75 A320neo family aircraft and 35 A330neo family aircraft.

international_aviation.summary: 西班牙直升機營運商Eliance已申請初步債權人保護。AeroTime報導稱，這項程序距將公司置於司法監管僅一步之遙；報導並指出，申請與Eliance財務困境及據稱的短期流動性問題有關。
international_aviation.headline_en: Spanish helicopter operator Eliance files for preliminary creditor protection
international_aviation.summary_en: Spanish helicopter operator Eliance has filed for preliminary creditor protection. AeroTime says the move is one step short of placing the business under judiciary supervision and was prompted by Eliance’s troubled financial situation, with reported short-term liquidity issues.

international_aviation.headline: 希斯洛機場（LHR）稱逾40家航空公司尋求時段，擴建呼聲升高
international_aviation.summary: 希斯洛機場（LHR）表示，目前有超過40家航空公司尋求取得機場時段，擴建及興建第三條跑道的呼聲也在升高。機場管理層於2026年10月12日表示，時段需求持續超過可用容量；管理層稱，航空公司因此被迫選擇海外競爭樞紐，並使英國失去連結、貿易與成長機會。
international_aviation.headline_en: Heathrow Says More Than 40 Airlines Seek Slots as Expansion Calls Intensify
international_aviation.summary_en: London-Heathrow Airport (LHR) says more than 40 airlines are currently seeking access to its slots, as calls for expansion and a third runway intensify. Airport management said on October 12, 2026, that demand for access continues to exceed available capacity. It said this is forcing airlines to choose competing hubs overseas and taking connectivity, trade and growth opportunities away from the UK.

international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus U740 Valkyrie completes first European flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus says the U740 Valkyrie uncrewed combat aircraft has completed its first flight in Europe. The flight took place at a test facility in Northern Europe, and Airbus said the aircraft achieved all objectives.

international_aviation.headline: Cummings Aerospace展示單人操控兩架Hellhound S3攻擊無人機
international_aviation.summary: Cummings Aerospace於10月12日宣佈，該公司已展示以單一手持控制器同時操作兩架噴射動力Hellhound S3攻擊無人機。公司表示，這項測試於2026年8月25日在奧勒岡州Pendleton UAS Range進行，兩架無人機自一具安裝於Polaris多用途車輛上的新型發射器依序發射。
international_aviation.headline_en: Cummings Aerospace demonstrates single-operator control of two Hellhound S3 attack drones
international_aviation.summary_en: Cummings Aerospace announced on October 12, 2026, that it had demonstrated the simultaneous operation of two jet-powered Hellhound S3 attack drones using a single handheld controller. The company said the test took place on August 25, 2026, at the Pendleton UAS Range in Oregon, with the drones launched sequentially from a new launcher mounted on a Polaris utility vehicle.
